allJobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
allJobs.description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

  • Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

  • The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer.

What you need

  • 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers.

  • Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer.

  • Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates.

  • Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and keep it on track when something does not work.

  • Real AI curiosity: you use LLM tools yourself and can explain clearly what Qorelo does and where its limits are.

  • Willingness to travel within Europe for on-site demos and workshops.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base.

 

You might be a fit if

  • You have been the person customers want in the room for the demo, and the one consultants call when the connection does not work.

  • You have worked at an SAP consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor and want to be closer to a product.

  • You enjoy a full day of workshops at a customer and can still explain clearly afterwards what worked, what did not and why.

  • You have taken software through an enterprise IT and security onboarding and know why it takes as long as it does.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo runs in the field. We are looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior customer-facing technical talent in Berlin.

  • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. You work at the core of SAP systems most engineers never get to touch.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to our CTO, our founding engineer and our solution architects.

  • 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg – where you work when you are not with customers. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Gaspar, our founding engineer (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your SAP and customer-facing background with Marino, our CTO (60 min)

  3. Practical case: a workshop and live demo simulation with our engineers and solution architects

  4. Offer

How to apply

Send us your CV at

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

allJobs.title: Senior Talent Partner
allJobs.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

  • Acts as each hiring manager's partner on a search, not an order-taker: shaping the brief, setting the bar together, and holding the process to it

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are succeeding if:

  • Hiring managers across engineering and non-engineering teams get strong shortlists when they need them, not a quarter later.

  • Regardless of source, the candidates are some of the best talent around, rather than people who happened to apply - and you can recognise the difference.

  • Every search you run has a clear brief, a consistent structured process, and no candidate waiting more than 3 days to hear from us.

  • The people you hire are still here and doing well a year on. We scaled sustainably, not just quickly.

  • A talent community exists around WunderGraph that didn't before: people who know us, follow what we do, and raise their hand when the right role opens.

  • Candidates keep telling us ours is the best hiring process they've been through, including the ones we don't hire. You keep it that way as we hire more.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Running role kickoffs with hiring managers to agree outcomes, competencies and the interview loop

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Pre-screening candidates and sharing shortlists with a clear recommendation

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

  • Managing offers and closing candidates honestly, without pressure, ensuring each conversation with the candidates is meaningful and insightful for both us and the candidate.

Sourcing

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

Stakeholders and reporting

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

Talent community and employer marketing

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • Keeping our hiring data and Ashby setup useful for planning, not just record-keeping23w

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You're a strong sourcer. You find people who aren't looking, and your outreach gets replies because it's written for the person reading it.

  • You tell a company's story in a way that makes the right candidates lean in: honest, specific, never a hard sell.

  • You keep several very different searches moving at once without letting candidate experience slip.

  • You work independently and keep things moving when the path isn't clear, without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You're based in Europe or the UK and can regularly overlap with US hours. For CET or EEST, that means some later evenings.

Bonus points

  • You've built or redesigned a technical hiring process (the loop, the task, the scorecard), not just run one.

  • You've built a talent community or run creative employer marketing that led to real hires.

  • You've hired in, or for stakeholders in, the US market.

  • You've handled hiring compliance, contracts or background checks across more than one European country.

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

  • Meet the founders

  • Culture fit call with team members

  • Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

Compensation: €60 – €75,000

  • EMEA • Base salary, depending on experience €60 – €75,000

allJobs.title: Senior Product Designer EMEA
allJobs.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.


TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success


ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

  • Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

  • Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

  • Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Product Design

  • Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

  • Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

  • Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

  • Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

  • Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

  • Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.

UX Research & Strategy

  • Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

  • Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

  • Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

  • Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

  • Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

  • Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

  • Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.

Web & Brand Experience

  • Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.

  • Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.

  • Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.

  • Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.

  • Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.

  • Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort München: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice und bist in Kanzleien in Bayern und Baden-Württemberg unterwegs – München, Augsburg, Stuttgart. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

  • Du zeigst Pennylane im Kanzleialltag: Demos, die den konkreten Nutzen für Kanzlei und Mandanten zeigen, nicht die Feature-Liste.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 📍 München/Süddeutschland: Homeoffice plus Kundentermine in deiner Region, monatliche Teamtage in Berlin.

  • 🚀 Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – du steigst in der Gründungsphase von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter variabler Anteil, der quartalsweise ausgezahlt wird.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für dein Homeoffice und eine monatliche Pauschale für einen Coworking-Space in deiner Stadt.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Firms-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • Du führst beratende Discovery-Gespräche mit Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen, verstehst ihre Abläufe mit Mandanten und hinterfragst den Status quo.

Über EVOLVE

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum. Jedes Jahr verwalten wir über 60 Millionen € Adspend und denken jedes Projekt von der Ad über den Funnel bis zur Marge. Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schau dir an, was dich bei uns erwartet.

Das wirst du tun

Du bist verantwortlich für verkaufsstarke Shopseiten und Funnels, die dafür sorgen, dass unsere Kunden den Markt outperformen.

  • Analyse: Du analysierst Shops, Landingpages und Funnels ganzheitlich und leitest daraus priorisierte Hypothesen und Maßnahmen ab

  • Kunden und Projekte: Du führst Kunden eigenständig durch den Optimierungsprozess und verantwortest Projekte bis zum messbaren Ergebnis

  • Trends: Du verfolgst die aktuellsten Trends im Brand- und Direct-Response-Marketing und bringst sie in unsere Methodik und Standards ein

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für deine eigenen Projekte, stehst damit aber nicht allein: Unsere Experten für UX-Design, Copywriting und Performance Marketing setzen deine Konzepte mit dir um. Dich erwartet ein Team, das für Ergebnisse, Verlässlichkeit und kreative Exzellenz steht, mit flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Feedbackkultur.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in CRO, E-Commerce oder UX, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder einem Shop mit relevantem Traffic

  • Sicherer Umgang mit GA4, Hotjar/Clarity und A/B-Tests

  • Fundiertes Verständnis für Positionierung, Customer Journey und Conversion-Psychologie

  • Klare Kommunikation, schriftlich wie im Kundengespräch

  • Hohe Eigenständigkeit: Du priorisierst konsequent und gibst klare Empfehlungen

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • Vollzeit mit einer 38-Stunden-Woche

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, JobRad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

Vielleicht fragst du dich gerade …

„Wie viele Projekte betreue ich parallel?“ Wenige, dafür aber in der Tiefe. So kannst du dich wirklich in jede Marke reindenken. Du arbeitest nicht am Fließband, sondern begleitest deine Kunden langfristig und siehst, was aus deinen Konzepten wird.

„Welche Rolle spielt AI bei euch?“ Eine große. ChatGPT und Claude werden deine besten Freunde, denn mit den modernsten AI-Workflows optimierst du deine Arbeit und das Ergebnis für deine Kunden. Dafür hast du vollen Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack. So bleibt mehr Zeit für das, was wirklich zählt: die richtigen Ideen für deine Kunden.

„100 % Remote, verliere ich da den Austausch?“ Nein. Wir sind eine Remote-Agentur, aber Persönlichkeit und Teamspirit bleiben erhalten. Du hast das Gefühl eines Office-Teams, nur ohne Lärm und ohne Fahrt ins Büro. Dafür sorgen regelmäßige Projektabstimmungen, unsere wöchentlichen Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats.

Vanessa, unsere HR-Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

allJobs.description:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Germany. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Meanwhile, we’re helping accountants. By using Pennylane, rather than doing manual and repetitive tasks, they can spend more time advising and guiding their clients.

About Strategy & Operations at Pennylane:

At Pennylane, being part of the Strategy & Operations team means deeply understanding operational realities. As we launch our German entity, we design and implement efficient, scalable solutions that enable Pennylane to reach and exceed its ambitious expansion targets. Your role will be pivotal in structuring local operations from scratch, scaling existing processes, and tailoring our operating model to the specificities of the German market. To make this launch a success, our Strategy & Operations teams work daily alongside Business teams (Sales, Success Managers), Tech teams (Developers, Product Managers), and Data teams (Data Scientists, Data Analysts).

The Goal

Significantly boost team productivity through better tool utilization, process simplification, and operational structuring to support the launch and expansion of our German entity.

You will be the owner, key point of contact, and driver of change within the Business Teams for the German market. You will work closely with operational managers leading Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Account Management.

Your Role

  • Drive transformation and challenge the status quo: Observe, listen, challenge existing setups, and continuously propose optimizations to reduce time spent on manual admin tasks or data searches. You will pave the way for future local growth, structure operations for a new entity, and document all procedural changes.

  • Implement operational improvements: Roll out solution-driven initiatives through new information systems, app modifications, or organizational changes. You will lead projects while leveraging cross-functional capabilities (Data, Sales, Finance, etc.). Your mission will also be to ensure high customer satisfaction, hit delivery deadlines, and monitor roll-out KPIs.

  • Scale and localize processes: Adapt global operational frameworks to German market specificities while remaining aligned with core Pennylane standards.

  • Benchmark and innovate: Observe other departments, take a step back, run benchmarks, and gather insights to refine operational strategies.

  • Enable teams and drive adoption: Implement strong communication and hands-on support for German teams to ensure smooth onboarding onto new methodologies (optimal tooling, training, continuous improvement). You will ensure daily tool adoption and process adherence.

  • Bridge Ops and Corporate strategy: Gain a high-level view of corporate challenges to anticipate their impact on local German operations and provide operational visibility through data-driven insights.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an ambitious professional with a proven track record in organizational transformation, productivity improvement, project management, and operational structuring in a fast-paced environment.

Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Languages: Fluent in German and English

  • Minimum of 4 years of proven experience in business transformation and operational efficiency through system and tool implementation.

  • First-hand experience or a strong appetite for market launches, entity structuring, or scaling operations.

  • Strong natural curiosity and drive to make a real impact: active listener and sharp observer.

  • End-to-end project management experience: ability to scope problems quickly, execute fast, and iterate without waiting for perfection.

  • Ability to balance granular detail with a high-level strategic perspective.

  • Strong business acumen.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to simplify complex issues.

  • Appetite for or knowledge of AI, No-Code tools, and process automation.

  • Strong analytical skills (proficiency in SQL is a plus).

  • Familiarity with SaaS business operations and tools like Salesforce and Intercom is a plus.

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 This job is based in Berlin with an on-site presence a few days per week at our Berlin office (Rosenthaler Strasse 43–45).

💵 An attractive package (detailed during the screening stage)

Warum diese Rolle?

Mehr als Accounting: Du verbindest operative Finance-Expertise mit Prozessgestaltung und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, wie unsere Accounting Operations heute funktionieren und morgen aufgestellt sind.

Gestaltungsspielraum im Scale-up: Du triffst auf ein wachsendes Unternehmen, in dem Du neue Prozesse aufbauen, bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Verbesserungen direkt umsetzt.

Automatisierung mit echtem Impact: Du hast die Möglichkeit, den Einsatz digitaler Tools und KI in unseren Finance-Prozessen voranzutreiben und neue Anwendungsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen, um manuelle Tätigkeiten Schritt für Schritt zu reduzieren.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Join us and help create a digital world where trust, transparency, and meaningful connections drive every interaction.

To strengthen our Customer Care team, we are looking for a 

Director Customer Care (m/f/d)

(Hybrid in Cologne, 8 days/month on site / Full-time / Permanent)

As we continue to scale our service excellence, we are looking for an experienced and hands-on leader to shape the future of Customer Care at Trusted Shops. In this role, you will drive operational performance, customer satisfaction, and service innovation across our consumer-facing services. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will help create secure, scalable, and customer-centric processes while leveraging automation and AI to deliver outstanding service experiences.

Your Responsibilities 

  • Lead, coach, and develop our Customer Care Team Leads, providing both strategic and disciplinary leadership.

  • Own and continuously improve key customer service KPIs such as AHT, SLA, and CSAT across all Customer Care operations.

  • Drive service excellence by evolving standards, processes, and workflows with a strong focus on customer centricity and efficiency.

  • Monitor and optimize operational performance across critical processes, including Buyer Protection, refunds, reviews, and related customer journeys.

  • Co-create and implement automation and AI initiatives that improve scalability, productivity, and service quality.

  • Partner closely with Operations, Product, Controlling, Sales, and Finance to deliver sustainable business and customer outcomes.

  • Degree in Business, Communication, or a comparable field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of leadership experience within Customer Care, Service Operations, or a comparable customer-focused environment, including experience leading leaders.

  • Proven track record of improving service KPIs, operational processes, and omnichannel customer support organizations.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and ticketing systems, ideally Zendesk or Salesforce, as well as AI-supported service automation initiatives

  • Proactive, solution-oriented leadership style with excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, ideally combined with experience with a works council.

  • Strong analytical approach to performance management, process improvement, and operational excellence.

  • Business-fluent English and German communication skills

About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

You’ll be the first engineer dedicated to our data platform, and you’ll design and build it largely from scratch. You’ll own the platform that collects our event data, models it, and serves it to customers with roughly 15-second freshness, including building our time-series foundations. This is a senior, hands-on role: you’ll set the architecture, write most of the code and set the bar for the data team that grows around you. You’ll work closely with our VP of Engineering, Product and our leadership team. Product decides which data products to build; you own how they’re built and what the data can support.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Designing and building real-time ingestion for three sources: events our platform already emits, new instrumentation in our product, and data our customers send us

  • Rebuilding our event streaming layer, with the authority to choose how

  • Modelling structured and time-series data in ClickHouse and Databricks so aggregations, trends and benchmarks are fast and cheap at scale (our current defaults, though you can make the case for change)

  • Designing the external data contracts and APIs customers build on, including versioning, reliability and isolation of each customer’s data

  • Defining the event contracts our product engineers instrument against

  • Owning the platform in production: monitoring, data quality, cost and on-call for the systems you build

Your First Year

In your first few months you’ll assess what we have, decide the platform architecture, and scope our first data product with Product and Engineering. After that, you’ll rebuild the streaming layer and ship the first external product on the new platform, most likely aggregated analytics or direct data access for customers. Later in the year you’ll help us hire a domain expert who decides which signals and benchmarks are worth building. Machine learning is out of scope for now; it comes once we have enough clean historical data.

Requirements

  • Production experience building real-time or near-real-time ingestion with event streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis or Redpanda

  • Deep experience with ClickHouse or a similar analytical database, including modelling time-series data for fast aggregation at volume

  • A track record of shipping an external, multi-tenant data product or data API that customers depended on (internal reporting pipelines alone won’t cover this)

  • Experience migrating a messy live system to a new one without downtime or data loss

  • Senior-level engineering habits: system design, testing, and running the services you build in production

  • Sound judgement working independently: you’ll be our most senior data voice, and we’ll rely on your technical calls

  • A product mindset: you won’t work directly with customers, but you’ll often be the person who knows what the data can and can’t support

Nice to Have

  • Experience in payments or with sensitive, regulated data

  • Databricks or Spark experience alongside ClickHouse

  • Experience as an early or founding member of a data team, including hiring

This Might Not Be for You If…

  • You’re mainly an analyst, BI or data science specialist: this role builds the platform and the external products on it

  • Your experience is mostly dashboards, internal reporting pipelines or modelling for analysis

We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.

 

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Underwriter to join our Underwriting team. As a Payment Facilitator, we onboard and oversee our merchants directly. You will assess and onboard a varied portfolio of these merchants, with a focus on marketplaces and platforms. You will own complex underwriting cases from start to finish. This includes reviewing ownership structures and financial health, setting risk exposure limits, and making clear recommendations that protect the business while helping our merchants grow.

This is a senior position. You will be expected to use sound independent judgement, guide less experienced colleagues, and help improve our underwriting policies, procedures and tools.

Key responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end underwriting and onboarding of merchants, including complex cases, ensuring decisions follow internal risk appetite, regulatory requirements and card scheme rules.
- Underwrite marketplaces and platforms, assessing the business model, flow of funds and customer journey.

- Screen merchants, directors, UBOs and connected parties for PEP status, sanctions and adverse media using screening tools, and assess and escalate potential matches appropriately.
- Review merchant websites using third-party website monitoring providers to identify content violations, prohibited or restricted products and services, missing or inadequate terms and conditions, refund and privacy policies, and inconsistencies with the declared business model.
- Carry out credit risk analysis on merchants by reviewing financial statements, management accounts and bank statements to evaluate liquidity, profitability, solvency and trading patterns.
- Assess financial exposure, including chargeback, refund and delivery risk (e.g., future delivery and prepayment models), and recommend suitable mitigants.
- Write clear, well-reasoned underwriting summaries and recommendations for approval, setting out key risks, mitigants and the rationale behind each decision.
- Conduct periodic reviews and re-underwriting of existing merchants, monitoring changes in risk profile, processing behaviour and financial standing.
- Work with Sales, Risk, Compliance and other teams to give timely, commercially aware risk decisions.
- Coach and support junior underwriters, reviewing their cases and sharing knowledge across the team.

Requirements

Essential:

- Extensive experience in merchant underwriting, merchant onboarding and credit risk within payments, acquiring, a payment service provider or a related financial services environment.
- Strong knowledge of KYB/KYC, AML and CTF requirements as they apply to merchant onboarding.
- Hands-on experience with PEP, sanctions and adverse media screening tools, and with investigating and resolving potential matches.
- Experience onboarding businesses with complex ownership and organisational structures, and identifying UBOs.
- The ability to perform in-depth credit risk analysis, including interpreting financial statements and bank statements and assessing a merchant's financial strength and risk exposure.

- Sound judgement and the confidence to make and defend risk decisions while balancing commercial objectives.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage several complex cases at once.
- Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, well-structured risk summaries and recommendations.
- Fluent written and spoken English.

Desirable:

We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure.

By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure.

Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch.

Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help advance the state of the art in speech synthesis.

You will work on research and development across the full speech pipeline — from model architecture and training to dataset design and production deployment. About Valiantys
 
Valiantys is a global leader in consulting and services for the Atlassian ecosystem, helping businesses transform their IT operations and business processes. With a focus on driving operational excellence, innovation, and agility, we empower organizations to achieve their goals through tailored solutions for Atlassian tools and adjacent technologies. 
Joining Valiantys means becoming part of a growing company driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and respect for individuals, where every contribution helps shape the digital future of businesses.
 
Job summary
 
As a Transformation Consultant, you will support client transformation initiatives by working alongside Principle Transformation Consultants and Delivery teams. You’ll help ensure smooth project execution, contribute to high-quality deliverables, and learn how to guide organizations through business and IT transformation journeys.
This role is an excellent opportunity to develop consulting skills, gain exposure to senior client stakeholders, and build expertise in transformation & change methodologies and the Atlassian ecosystem.
We are ideally looking for someone based in Paris. You will report to the Transformation Consulting Director.
 
 
Things you will be working on:
 
Solution Design & Value Creation
- Co-develop transformation offerings in collaboration with internal practices (e.g., Cloud, ITSM);
- Translate business and IT requirements into clear value propositions and project scopes;
- Contribute to building reusable approaches, templates, or frameworks (e.g., for ITSM transformation, cloud migration).
 
Change Management & Communication
- Support clients in their change journey by preparing communication materials, workshops, and training sessions.
- Help identify potential adoption challenges and propose ways to address them.
- Translate complex technical or process changes into clear, engaging messages for different audiences.
- Contribute to stakeholder analysis and change impact assessments.
 
Client Partnership & Engagement Delivery
- Serve as the main point of contact for client stakeholders across transformation initiatives;
- Understand clients’ business goals and align solutions based on the Atlassian stack and related technologies;
- Support delivery teams to ensure smooth execution, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction;
- Contribute to the coordination and success of transformation projects, focusing on measurable business value.
 
Business Development & Account Growth
- Support strategic planning and proposal efforts in close collaboration with sales and senior consultants;
- Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within assigned client accounts;
- Help develop go-to-market assets that position our capabilities in a clear and compelling way.
 
Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing
- Act as a sparring partner for contributing to knowledge growth and professional development;
- Share market and client insights internally to enhance offering development and delivery practices.
 
 
Do you have what it takes to be a Transformation Consultant :
 
You bring a minimum of 10y of consulting experience, ideally with exposure to business or IT transformation topics.
You have a proven track record of managing client relationships and contributing to account growth.
You have a strong interest in change management, communication, and user adoption, and you are eager to further develop your expertise in these areas.
 
With excellent communication skills in both English and French—whether written, verbal, or through presentations—you know how to structure information clearly and engage diverse stakeholders.
 
While not necessarily an expert, you're familiar with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar technologies.
 
You’ve worked with cross-functional teams and know how to bridge the gap between technical and business stakeholders.
 
Adaptable and proactive, you thrive in dynamic environments where you can balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving.
Why Join Valiantys?
 
Join a fast-growing, innovation-driven organization where transformation is at the heart of everything we do. You'll collaborate closely with top-tier experts in IT consulting, business transformation, and DevEx, all within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment that values impact, creativity, and continuous improvement.

-An international environment and a multicultural team;

allJobs.title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance
allJobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role: 

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement. 
  • A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale. 
  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams.
  • A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously. 

An ideal candidate also has: 

  • Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services.
  • Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies.  

Why Join Samsara? 

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy. 
  • Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results. 
  • Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement. 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. 

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. allJobs.description:
Job title: Accounts Payable Accountant (Comptable Fournisseurs)

Location: Paris

About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team

You’ll join the Accounting department within Ledger’s Finance team, working in an international context.

What you’ll be doing:

Supplier accounting

  • Match invoices against purchase orders

  • Record invoices and review items arriving on the approved platform

  • Prepare payment batches

  • Perform account reconciliation (lettrage)

  • Contribute to monthly, quarterly and annual closings (e.g. accrued expenses, shareholder current accounts)

  • Analyse and monitor accounts, including follow-ups and communication with suppliers and employees

  • Contribute to annual audits by answering the auditors’ questions

Expense reports

  • Review expense reports

  • Book entries, prepare payments and reconcile

  • Support the declaration of fees (honoraires)

This list is not exhaustive.

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum BTS, DUT or equivalent

  • Strong Excel skills

  • Knowledge of ERP systems is a real plus

  • Comfort with AI and current tools, and a willingness to work with AI (strongly recommended)

  • Rigour and an analytical mindset

  • Ability to communicate and work in a team

  • Good English level, required to work in an international environment

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance, including medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger (access to BSPCE under the current plan) as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee, including internal and external training and conference participation

  • Meal vouchers - Swile meal vouchers

  • Time off - 5 weeks of paid leave

  • Equipment - High-performance equipment for your work

  • Ledger life - Annual company outing (Ledger Days), annual parties, snacks and drinks at the office, and an employee discount on Ledger products

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

The team

The Consolidation team, part of Finance (Accounting & Consolidation), prepares the Group’s IFRS consolidated financial statements across multiple international legal entities. The team is moving its consolidation EPM tool from SAP BFC (ViaReport C&R) to Amelkis EPM, with a go-live targeted for Q1 2027, while preparing the 2026 annual closing. The intern supports both work streams and reports to the Consolidation Director.

What you’ll be doing:

Annual consolidation closing (2026)

  • Support the preparation of the Group’s IFRS consolidated financial statements across multiple legal entities

  • Assist with intercompany reconciliation and eliminations

  • Process consolidation adjustments and review reporting packages submitted by subsidiaries

  • Liaise with subsidiary finance teams to collect, control and consolidate reporting packages

  • Support ad hoc analyses requested during the annual audit

EPM tool migration (SAP BFC to Amelkis EPM)

  • Contribute to data migration, configuration and testing workshops for the new Amelkis consolidation/EPM tool

  • Participate in the “double run” phase to ensure data accuracy between the legacy and new systems

  • Help document consolidation processes and procedures throughout the tool transition

What we’re looking for:

  • Master’s-level student (Bac+4/5) in Accounting, Finance or Audit (DSCG, Master CCA, business or engineering school), looking for a gap year (césure) or an end-of-studies internship

  • First experience with, or strong interest in, consolidation and IFRS (previous internship, audit firm exposure or dedicated coursework)

  • Comfortable working with large data sets and advanced Excel functions

  • Curiosity for finance systems and tools (EPM, SAP BFC, Amelkis EPM) is a strong plus

  • Fluent in English and French (the team reports bilingually)

  • Rigorous and structured

What the internship offers

  • Hands-on exposure to IFRS consolidation in a fast-growing, international tech group

  • Active involvement in a live EPM tool migration (SAP BFC to Amelkis EPM), a skill highly valued in the finance job market

  • Close mentoring from the Consolidation Director and the wider accounting team

allJobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
allJobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

We are looking for multiple Software Engineer Interns to join some of Back Market’s Engineering teams in the Paris office. Depending on your interests and experience, you may contribute to projects across our product, platform, data, payments, shipping, customer experience or circularity teams.

Our Engineering teams build the technology that powers Back Market, from customer-facing experiences to the internal services used by our teams and partners. You will work alongside software engineers, product managers, designers, data analysts and other stakeholders in a collaborative and international environment.

With support from experienced engineers, you will learn how we design, develop, test, deploy and monitor reliable software in a production environment.

What you will do in this role

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will learn and contribute alongside experienced engineers:

  • Assist with developing and improving features, with guidance from your team.

  • Participate in writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions to learn from the team.

  • Help investigate bugs and support the resolution of technical issues.

  • Participate in testing, deployment and monitoring activities.

  • Work with product, design, data and operations teams to understand requirements.

  • Assist with maintaining technical documentation and sharing knowledge.

  • Explore different technologies and gradually build your skills across the software development lifecycle.

You will join an agile "build it and run it" environment, where teams take part in building, launching, monitoring and improving the products and services they own. Your level of responsibility will grow throughout the internship, with regular guidance and feedback from your team.

OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT 💻

The technologies you use will depend on the team you join. Our engineering environment may include:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, Golang and Django

  • Frontend: Vue.js, TypeScript, Nuxt and Revolve, our design system

  • Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ and BigQuery

  • Infrastructure and delivery: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Datadog, Argo CD, CircleCI and GitHub
